recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is for FHIR-14551. No follow-up source edit is needed for this issue; FHIR-14550 can be audited separately if it appears as a seed or bounded related issue.
issue_request: FHIR-14551 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-I change request asking the RESTful API batch/transaction paragraph to state request optionality unequivocally in light of FHIR-14550 and to avoid implying that transaction entries are processed independently like batch entries.
initial_application: Git-svn commit ffbcccb1db3608f46cc6d70fb5982c45144f5814, svn revision 14049, applied GF#14551 to source/http.html by changing the request details sentence to SHALL, removing the optional-request note, and adding the batch versus transaction succeed/fail distinction.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml includes source/http.html as the RESTful API page. Current source/http.html still has the SHALL request-details language, describes batch as independent actions and transaction as atomic, and reiterates that batch entries are individual interactions while transaction interactions either succeed or fail together. FHIR-14550 is the related Published/Persuasive decision that made Bundle.entry.request mandatory for batch and transaction bundles; current batch and transaction Bundle profiles require Bundle.entry.request for method slices. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches found no FHIR-14551-specific community evidence that changes the conclusion.
reconciliation: No source changes were made because the current RESTful API source already conveys the issue's required behavior for request details, PUT/POST resource bodies, batch processing, and transaction all-or-nothing behavior.
